feedstockProfiles.name: Whey Protein Isolate & Hydrolysate (WPI 90, 36% Feed Solids)
feedstockProfiles.description: High-purity dairy protein feed. Denatures rapidly if exposed to high air temperatures (>95°C wet bulb). Wall deposits undergo severe Maillard browning, liberating volatile off-odors and forming smoldering char.

feedstockProfiles.name: Maltodextrin DE 15 Carrier Slurry (High Viscosity, 55% Solids)
feedstockProfiles.description: Common encapsulation carrier and starch derivative. High viscosity requires high centrifugal shearing forces to prevent formation of coarse satellite droplets that impact chamber walls before complete drying.

feedstockProfiles.name: High-Sugar Fruit Juice Concentrate (High Fructose/Glucose, 42% Solids)
